text.p: The Harvey Group Inc said on Wednesday that a reorganization that would give existing stockholders one percent of the company.

In March, Harvey Group had said it completed negotiations for its reorganization and it would be filed with the bankruptcy court. The company was not immediately available to say whether or not the conditions had changed since then.

Harvey Group said 90.5 percent of the common equity of the reorganized electronics retailer will be issued to new investors after converting $3.0 million in debtor-in- possession financing into equity.
Unsecured creditors will get 8.5 percent of Harvey Group's equity, the company said.
Harvey Group also said $875,000 subordinated secured debt will be converted into $875,000 of redeemable convertible preferred stock.
